_about: The Goblin Warrens (levels 12-25): goblins who swarm to each other's screech, the merchant calling for help, the cave trolls and spiders as elites, the goblin shaman a sub-boss, and Goblin King Grizznak on his throne calling berserkers to his side.

797350.name: cave troll brute
797350.long_desc: A cave troll brute squats among cracked bones, eyeing you with dim, hungry interest.
797350.description: A great grey-green troll with arms that hang to its knees and a jaw full of broken teeth. The goblin king keeps its kind as enforcers, and pays them in meat. It gnaws a thighbone while it watches you, and it has not decided yet whether you are trouble or dinner.
797350.why: the warrens' cave trolls in their den

patrols.why: a goblin scout runs the tunnels

bosses.why: the goblin shaman in his sanctum (the Shaman's Sanctum, not the mushroom farm)
the massive cave spider in its nest (Spider Nest Cavern, not the goblin barracks)
